P201  NERD-TEXT 201   12.11.26 15:07 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (1/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-124194                       
  MS Outlook: Remote Spoofing Bug       
                                        
  Unauthenticated remote threat actors  
  can bypass safety prompts to forge    
  actions across networks. Added to CISA
  KEV catalog with mandatory remediation
  enforced for federal systems.         
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

P202  NERD-TEXT 202   12.11.26 15:07 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (2/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-111793                       
  Webtop: Document Transcoder Flaw      
                                        
  An improper sphere resource transfer  
  bug allows authenticated attackers to 
  bypass conversion guards and process  
  arbitrary files. CISA adds flaw to KEV
  list due to active exploitation risks.
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

P203  NERD-TEXT 203   12.11.26 15:07 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (3/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-20320                        
  Cisco BroadWorks: Remote XXE Leak     
                                        
  Improper XML external entity parsing  
  lets unauthenticated network attackers
  extract internal configuration files  
  remotely. CISA adds flaw to the Known 
  Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.    
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

  Debian: Apache2 Security Patch        
                                        
  Debian maintainers have issued an     
  urgent update for the apache2 HTTP

  security flaws across stable

P205  NERD-TEXT 205   12.11.26 15:07 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  Ubuntu: Yodl Buffer Over-Read DoS     
                                        
  An input validation issue causes a    
  memory buffer over-read during        
  document parsing in Yodl. Specially   
  crafted files trigger process crashes,
  enabling remote denial of service     
  conditions.                           
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)

  USB 1.1 stutter.
